### The Penalty for Blasphemy
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-penalty-for-blasphemy
Passage: Leviticus 24:16
Points:
- Blaspheming the Lord's name in the midst of His camp displayed an audacious hardness of heart.
- Stoning as a penalty demonstrates that God takes His holiness and honor far more seriously than fallen humans do.
- Because the law holds every sinner accountable, everyone must look to Christ's atonement for justification.
- Any believer who feels genuine remorse and desires pardon has not committed the unforgivable sin against the Spirit.

### I am the Blasphemer!
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/i-am-the-blasphemer/
Passage: Leviticus 24:10-16
Points:
- The offender's curse reflected open disrespect and contempt for the living God.
- Every person by nature lives for self-glory rather than God's glory, sharing in the blasphemer's guilt and condemnation.
- Jesus, the only person who perfectly honored the Father, was ironically condemned and put to death under the accusation of blasphemy.
- On the cross, Christ bore the penalty due to rebels so that repentant blasphemers could receive His righteousness and grace.
